- [USER] The user is interested in learning more about the gender pay gap, specifically how it affects women of color.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided statistics on the gender pay gap: Women earn on average 82 cents for every dollar earned by men; Black women earn 61 cents, Latinas earn 53 cents, Native American women earn 58 cents, Asian women earn 85 cents, and Pacific Islander women earn 59 cents for every dollar earned by white men.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned that the gender pay gap has remained relatively stagnant and may take until 2059 for women to reach parity with men in the U.S.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Discussed intersectionality, noting that women with disabilities earn 69 cents for every dollar earned by men with disabilities, and lesbian women earn 14% less than straight women.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Identified key factors contributing to the gender pay gap for women of color, including occupational segregation, lack of access to education and training, discrimination and bias, and caregiving responsibilities.
